headline: BRICS Summit Delegates Secretly Pivot Entire Geopolitical Strategy Around Who Can Best Recommend A Mid-Range Vacuum Cleaner
body: International diplomats gathering for the latest economic summit have officially abandoned all trade talks in favor of debating the suction power and warranty terms of various household appliances. Sources confirm that global leaders are currently ignoring multi-trillion dollar trade agreements to focus exclusively on finding a consensus on which brand of vacuum offers the most reliable maneuverability for rug-heavy living rooms.
caption: When the world's most powerful leaders decide the real threat isn't inflation, but dusty carpets. Who knew geopolitics was just a glorified home appliance review session? #BRICS #Diplomacy #VacuumLife #GlobalTrade (satire)
